needed_items.description: 25 kg bags of premium rice, pulses, cooking oil, and nutritious lentils for resident children's daily meals.
Sturdy steel double bunk beds with supportive high-density foam mattresses and clean bedsheets.
Complete sets of tailored school uniforms, white socks, and durable leather school shoes for students.
Spacious wooden study desks and ergonomic study chairs for daily evening homework and tuition hours.
Pediatric emergency medicines, digital thermometers, antiseptic lotions, bandages, and hygiene kits.
Children's illustrated encyclopedias, bilingual storybooks, dictionaries, and practical science learning kits.

supporters.message: It is a true blessing to monitor the health and wellbeing of these wonderful, energetic children at Rise a Child.
